_comment: Snake locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Do NOT translate the move/direction tokens the player types ([up], [down], [left], [right], w, s, a, d) or the ASCII board rendered into {board}.

_slots.{num_players}: Number of players in the match
_slots.{board}: The rendered ASCII grid; keep neutral, never translate its characters
_slots.{groups}: Neutral ranking data (a list of player-id groups, worst to best); do not translate

player_prompt.intro:
{num_players}-Zogo Serpente su na {width}×{height} griglia.
Tu controłi serpente {player_id}. Movi vałidi: '[up]'/'[down]'/'[left]'/'[right]' (o w/s/a/d).
Ojetivo: supravivere el più longo o èsar el più longo e otègnere el pì alto puntejo (łimite de turni {max_turns} turni).

game_action.invalid_death: Snake {player_id} xe morto par via de na mossa no valida.

outcome.survived_win: El xugador {player_id} el xe sopravvissù; tuti i altri i ga perìo.
outcome.all_dead_simul: Tuti i serpenti xe morti in isteso momento.
outcome.outlived: El xugador el ga vissù più de tuti i altri.
outcome.turn_limit: El limite de turno xe rivà - el miglior scor vinse la pareggia.
